scenarios.label: Stable cached dashboard
scenarios.cached_state: Fresh cached observations match the approved baseline and show no meaningful movement.

scenarios.label: Explainable movement
scenarios.cached_state: A material movement is present, but the approved seasonal or operating context already explains it.

scenarios.label: Corroborated actionable movement
scenarios.cached_state: A material movement is corroborated by fresh related signals and the cached evidence supports a notification.

scenarios.label: Ambiguous movement requiring diagnosis
scenarios.cached_state: A material movement is real, but the cached evidence does not identify the likely driver. A bounded diagnostic query could explain it.

scenarios.label: Stale or failed source
scenarios.cached_state: The source is stale or failed its freshness contract, so business interpretation is unsafe.

scenarios.label: Metric definition or grain conflict
scenarios.cached_state: Two related charts disagree on population or grain. A governed definition and bounded quality query are needed before action.

scenarios.label: Cross-card diagnostic cluster
scenarios.cached_state: Several cards share a suspected driver. One shared diagnostic query can serve the cluster instead of each agent exploring independently.
